purpose: Non-admission discovery registry of additional hazard-observation and physical-context sources relevant to catastrophe risk.

entries.name: Copernicus CEMS Global Flood Monitoring v4.1.1
entries.provider: Copernicus Emergency Management Service / Global Flood Awareness System
entries.temporal_scope: Sentinel-1 archive from 2015 plus near-real-time monitoring; operational v4.1.1 from June 2026
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Sentinel-1 SAR-derived flood and water products with 10 m input pixel sampling and multiple uncertainty/advisory layers
entries.note: GFM is an automated Sentinel-1 ensemble flood-mapping system, not a direct water-depth observation; preserve product version, acquisition footprint, exclusion/advisory flags and uncertainty layers.

entries.name: MODIS Terra+Aqua MCD64A1 Burned Area v6.1
entries.resolution_or_granularity: monthly 500 m burned-area grids with burn-date and quality information
entries.note: MCD64A1 maps approximate burn date from MODIS reflectance and active-fire observations; preserve Collection 6.1, QA/uncertainty fields and the distinction between burned area and active-fire detections.

entries.name: ETOPO 2022 15 Arc-Second Global Relief Model
entries.provider: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information
entries.resolution_or_granularity: 15 arc-second global grids with Ice Surface and Bedrock variants plus source-ID and geoid products
entries.note: ETOPO 2022 integrates heterogeneous topographic and bathymetric inputs and provides distinct ice-surface/bedrock products; source-ID, vertical reference and navigation limitations must remain explicit.

entries.name: EMODnet Bathymetry Digital Terrain Model 2024
entries.provider: European Marine Observation and Data Network / European Commission
entries.spatial_scope: European seas plus the EMODnet 2024 Caribbean DTM region
entries.resolution_or_granularity: 1/16 x 1/16 arc-minute grid, approximately 115 m, with source-reference and quality-index layers
entries.note: The DTM combines many surveys and composite products and exposes provenance/quality layers; freeze release, region, LAT/MSL vertical reference and source-reference semantics before use.

entries.name: Meteosat Third Generation Lightning Imager Level 2
entries.spatial_scope: MTG Lightning Imager field of view from geostationary orbit near 0 degrees longitude
entries.resolution_or_granularity: continuous optical total-lightning detections grouped into events, groups and flashes
entries.note: LI detects optical total-lightning activity rather than surface damage or precipitation; freeze product processing version and preserve event/group/flash definitions and detection-efficiency limitations.

entries.name: World Stress Map Database Release 2025
entries.provider: GFZ Helmholtz Centre for Geosciences / World Stress Map Project
entries.resolution_or_granularity: quality-ranked point records of present-day crustal stress indicators
entries.note: The 2025 database is a heterogeneous quality-ranked stress compilation, not a probabilistic earthquake-hazard model; preserve indicator type, quality class and release identity.

entries.name: GFZ Geomagnetic Kp Index
entries.spatial_scope: planetary geomagnetic index derived from contributing observatories
entries.temporal_scope: historical definitive series plus continuously updated nowcast products
entries.resolution_or_granularity: 3-hour Kp index with derived ap, Ap, Cp and C9 products
entries.note: Definitive and nowcast Kp are distinct maturity states; preserve DOI/versioning, contributing-observatory provenance and the distinction between Kp and derived indices.

entries.name: NOAA SWPC Real-Time Solar Wind
entries.spatial_scope: upstream solar-wind observations near the Sun-Earth L1 point
entries.temporal_scope: archive from 1998 plus continuously updated operational data
entries.resolution_or_granularity: spacecraft-dependent magnetometer and thermal-plasma time series with resolution up to seconds
entries.note: The operational source spacecraft can switch between DSCOVR and ACE during outages; source spacecraft, data-quality flags, cadence and processing state must be explicit in any reproducible use.
